fields.name: Foreign shard
fields.definition: Relative to a record, any shard other than the one that holds it. A record that refers to a record on a foreign shard must store that record's shard id alongside its key, and no database-enforced foreign key can cover the relationship. ArgentSea helps locate such references: it can collect the foreign shards named by a list of keys or keyed models into a shards values argument for a targeted fan-out query, and the Mapper can read a foreign shard id from a column named in a shard key mapping.
